definitions.currency: on-time CLOUD answers only (D177). device_on_time is never added to any numerator here

query_type.rule: device-id prefix: dash -> alert, robo -> recall, asst -> assistance

alert_per_episode_attainment.episode_key_source: d178_deficit_feed_proofs.json f_replay_committed_live_cell independent._how; chosen over the EP-G prompt-token law because it is readable from the outcome row alone and therefore sees episodes the policy never served
alert_per_episode_attainment.denominator_source: D178 (1) declared constant: positions 2 to 20 inclusive of the 21-frame episode, verified on a committed cell at 714 episodes, instants per episode min 2 / median 19 / max 19
alert_per_episode_attainment.denominator_bias_measured: flat 19 gives 0.1467 against the true per-episode 0.1427 on covex-v6-state seed 5, so the constant costs +0.0040; both are reported
alert_per_episode_attainment.target_source: D178 (1), spec v6 sections 2 and 8; also the committed scorer's p_dash
alert_per_episode_attainment.both_reported: MEAN PER-EPISODE and POOLED, and only the per-episode one answers check 1; on covex-v6-state seed 5 the per-episode shortfall is 0.1427 and the pooled shortfall is 0.0411, a factor of 3.5
alert_per_episode_attainment.attainment_vs_shortfall: attainment_e = on_time_e / 19, shortfall_e = max(0, 0.25 - attainment_e); the mean clipped shortfall is NOT 0.25 minus the mean attainment and the two are reported separately
alert_per_episode_attainment.check_1_quantity: the MEAN PER-EPISODE ATTAINMENT, compared against the base's. The fraction of episodes at or above 0.25 is reported beside it because that is the other reading of 'target attainment' and the two can disagree

robot_retention.gain: rung2 on-time fraction minus base on-time fraction
robot_retention.denominator: sweep[0].robot_pool_n, every robo00x opportunity in the cell; not the feasible subset and not a distinct-question count, because a D159 (C) re-ask is its own opportunity with its own 3.0 s deadline
robot_retention.pool_equality_guard: the pool is trace-determined and must be EQUAL across arms at a seed; on the committed comparators it is 132 / 127 / 121 / 105 for both arms, and an inequality is a STOP, not a rescaling

near_zero_or_negative_denominator.NORMAL: gain >= +0.01: retained is the ratio, bar 0.90
near_zero_or_negative_denominator.NO_GAIN_TO_RETAIN: |gain| < 0.01: the ratio is null and the check is VACUOUS for that seed and said to be; the absolute fallback applies
near_zero_or_negative_denominator.NEGATIVE_GAIN: gain <= -0.01: the ratio is reported but marked UNINTERPRETABLE because its sign inverts; the absolute fallback applies
near_zero_or_negative_denominator.absolute_fallback: shares' GAIN OVER BASE must be at least the RUNG-2 base's
near_zero_or_negative_denominator.no_seed_dropped: every seed is reported with its gain_class, never dropped

robot_retention.committed_gains: base-to-rung2 gain is +0.629 / +0.693 / +0.545 / +0.610 on seeds 4 to 7
robot_retention.NOT_by_deadline: robot_headline.correct_answers_delivered_by_deadline is an ACCURACY, not an on-time rate: its own `metric` field says correct_answers_delivered_by_deadline, and its definition is the cloud's answer when delivered within the deadline, ELSE THE DEVICE'S if the device's also arrived in time, else a miss. It is NOT the quantity check 2 names, for two separate reasons, and substituting it changes the check twice over. First, an on-time wrong answer scores zero and a correct late answer scores zero, so it is not a deadline-attainment rate. Second, it ADMITS THE DEVICE SIDE, which D177 and D179 (6) exclude: the currency is on-time CLOUD answers only and device_on_time is reported beside, never added. The device floor is 0.371212 on all three arms at seed 4, identical, and the measured consequence is large: on seed 4 the on-time retention is (0.454545 - 0.265152) / (0.893939 - 0.265152) = 0.3012 while the by_deadline retention is (0.545455 - 0.469697) / (0.613636 - 0.469697) = 0.5267, because the accuracy reading compresses the numerator by 2.5x and the denominator by 4.4x. The two are reported side by side and the ON-TIME one is the check.

assistance_within_2s.unit_PRIMARY: the DEVICE (D178 (1)): every asst00x device at or above 0.90. The pooled fraction and the per-device minimum are reported beside
assistance_within_2s.denominator: OFFERED assistance opportunities (sweep[0].ss_pool_n = 357 on seed 4 against d181_share_floors.json's 1,429 over the four base cells), not completions: a completions denominator reads 100 percent for a device whose questions are all being declined, the exact case these checks exist to catch
assistance_within_2s.same_test: for assistance 'within 2 s' and 'on time' are the same test

definitions.W_register: live W is submit to FIRST TOKEN, dry W is submit to SETTLE (on_first is wired only when a real backend exists, procsplit.py:430-433); the dry report's 13.43 percent of virtual time above W_max and its 3.56x high water are SETTLE-basis and size nothing, so a live cell's W is never compared to them
definitions.overrun_signature_check: in the dry cell recall was present in ALL 18,476 overruns with no exception, so an overrun with no recall in it is NEW and is flagged loudly
definitions.seeds_permitted: 0, 4, 5, 6, 7 only; never 1 to 3 and never HOLDOUT

positive_control._what: the scorer re-derives six committed counts per cell from outcomes.jsonl.gz plus request.jsonl.gz and must match the cell's own score.sweep[0] block EXACTLY
positive_control._if_it_fails: THIS SCORER IS BROKEN AND THE CELL IS NOT. Report the scorer failure, not the comparison.

_HEADLINE.verdict: *** covex-v6-final (RUNG 4) FAILS CHECK 2 AT SEED 7, BY ONE ANSWER. check 1 PASS, check 2 FAIL, check 3 PASS. *** Retained 0.892307 against the 0.90 bar; 77 on-time robot answers where 78 were needed; gain_class NORMAL; the absolute fallback also fails (delta 0.552381 < gain 0.619048).

*** THE COMPLETE FOUR-SEED RESULT FOR RU.checks_1_and_3: PASS at ALL FOUR SEEDS, on both alert rules, with the two rules agreeing every time.
*** THE COMPLETE FOUR-SEED RESULT FOR RU._so: the ladder's top rung fails its pre-registered robot-retention test at THREE SEEDS OF FOUR, and the one pass is the HIGHEST-margin seed. The failures are not marginal in aggregate even though s7's is marginal individually: 0.851, 0.871, 0.892 against a 0.90 bar.

_HEADLINE._the_threshold_was_PRE_COMPUTED_and_held: before this cell existed, from base 19 of 105 and fair-final 84 of 105, the threshold was published as EXACTLY 78 of 105, with 78 passing at 0.9077 and 77 FAILING AT 0.8923. The cell came in at 77 and the scorer returned retained = 0.892307. A bar computed and published before the number exists cannot be accused of having moved toward the result, and this is the second seed where that pre-computation held exactly (s6's threshold of 104 also held).
_HEADLINE.*** THE CHECK-1 MISREADING, CORRECTED, B: the H100 observed that rung 4's dashcam is DOWN 265 answers against fair-final at s7, the first seed where that happens, and warned the per-episode check 'against fair-final's may FAIL too'. IT DOES NOT, BECAUSE CHECK 1 IS NOT AGAINST THE COMPARATOR. The scorer's own label is '1. alert per-episode target attainment AT LEAST THE BASE'S' and the scored field is delta_shares_minus_base. Shares 0.628778 against BASE 0.553811 is +0.074967, a PASS, and being below the comparator's 0.648312 is IRRELEVANT TO CHECK 1. Reading a check against the wrong reference arm would have manufactured a failure the pre-registration does not contain.
_HEADLINE._BUT_the_observation_underneath_it_IS_im: at s4, s5 and s6 rung 4 was LEVEL OR SLIGHTLY UP on alerts against rung 3 while losing robot answers, so it could be described as a TRADE. *** AT s7 IT IS DOWN ON BOTH: alert per-episode -0.019534 against the comparator (0.628778 vs 0.648312) and dashcam -265 on-time answers, WHILE ALSO losing 7 robot answers. *** So at s7 there is no trade at all and rung 4 is simply WORSE THAN RUNG 3 ON BOTH DIMENSIONS. The trade framing holds for s4 to s6 and must not be extended to s7.
_HEADLINE._servable_denominator_reported_beside: 18 of the 105 robot questions at s7 are the D176 over-32k set, VERIFIED BY ME as the identical set from the cell's own outcomes (intersection 18, zero either way), and no arm of ours can serve them. So the SERVABLE pool is 87: shares 77 of 87, fair-final 84 of 87. THE PRE-REGISTERED BAR STAYS ON THE OFFERED DENOMINATOR OF 105 - moving it to 87 after the numbers exist would be moving the bar - but a reader cannot interpret 0.733 without knowing that 18 were unservable by construction.
_HEADLINE._what_is_NOT_decided_here: a measurement. Supersession of rung 4, whether to fix the verified hard-zero queueing term and re-run, whether to wire the absent metrics link that has kept protect-and-defer unreachable in every cell to date, and what the paper claims, are ALL THE USER'S CALLS and are reported unresolved. Note the last two interact: with the KV metric plumbed, rung 4's protect-and-defer limb would be reachable FOR THE FIRST TIME, so these four seeds do not測 test the design as intended.
